_meta.status: Experiment on branch data-lab, not merged into the pipeline.

envelope.ambient_oxygen: o2_pct recorded and o2_basis equal to 'ambient' (the rule of match_environments in pipeline/run.py: any other basis is marked not_ambient)
envelope.counted_tests: need_tests.csv rows with objective_link equal to 'stated'
envelope.degenerate_hull: fewer than 3 non-collinear distinct points: hull kind 'point' or 'segment', reported as 'no area'; inside is true only where the nominal point coincides with the point or lies on the segment
envelope.gap_sign: gap = nearest recorded value minus nominal value; positive means the nearest recorded value is above the nominal value; 0 means a test has exactly the nominal value; where two recorded values are equally near (one above, one below), both are listed
envelope.gravity: count of tests whose gravity_level string equals the scenario's gravity_level string; a scenario with gravity_level null sets none
envelope.hull: convex hull of the distinct recorded (o2_pct, pressure_kpa) points, monotone chain, exact rational arithmetic, no tolerance
envelope.hull_boundary: a point on an edge or a vertex of the hull is reported as position 'boundary' and counted as inside
envelope.number_reading: every cell and every spec number is read as the exact decimal it is written as (Python fractions.Fraction of the written string); differences are exact
envelope.pareto: a test is listed when no other test of the set has |delta o2_pct| <= its |delta o2_pct| and |delta pressure_kpa| <= its |delta pressure_kpa| with at least one of the two strictly smaller; deltas = test value minus nominal value; no combined distance, no weight, no scaling; tests with identical deltas are all listed
envelope.ranges: the in_range rule of pipeline/run.py (RANGE_DEFAULTS: min inclusive, max exclusive unless stated) applied to the scenario's ranges; a range the scenario does not set is reported as not set; the joint count requires oxygen and pressure both inside and is asserted equal to tests_atmosphere of scenario_needs.csv
envelope.scenarios_without_nominal: a scenario whose nominal is empty gets no nominal-point numbers; its ranges are reported where set

order_changes.classes: for materials a, b and condition columns c1, c2: s1 = sign(a[c1] - b[c1]), s2 = sign(a[c2] - b[c2]); same_order if s1 = s2 != 0; reversed if s1 = -s2 != 0; tie_in_one if exactly one of s1, s2 is 0; tie_in_both if both are 0
order_changes.column_pairs: every unordered pair of condition columns, in the column order of the spec
order_changes.kendall_tau_b: tau_b = (n_c - n_d) / sqrt((n_0 - n_1)(n_0 - n_2)), n_0 = n(n-1)/2 material pairs, n_c = same_order pairs, n_d = reversed pairs, n_1 = pairs tied in c1 (tie_in_both included), n_2 = pairs tied in c2; given exactly as numerator and the integer under the square root, and as a decimal rounded half-even to 'tau_b_digits' digits; undefined where the square root is 0
order_changes.material_pairs: every unordered pair of materials, in the row order of the item
order_changes.values: values are read as printed in the reference item's 'values' (exact decimals; JSON numbers read as decimal strings), no tolerance

search.rule: every reference item with a 'values' field is looked at; a table qualifies with at least 3 materials (rows) and at least 2 condition columns holding the same quantity. Every item with 'values' that is not in 'tables' must be listed here with a reason, or the script stops.

what_each_number_is.axes.min, axes.max: Smallest and largest recorded value of the axis over those tests.
what_each_number_is.axes.nearest: The recorded value(s) closest to the nominal value on that axis alone, the gap (value minus nominal) and the number of tests at that value.
what_each_number_is.axes.tests_recorded: Of the tests with ambient oxygen, the number with the axis (o2_pct or pressure_kpa) recorded.
what_each_number_is.counted_tests: Number of tests of need_tests.csv with objective_link 'stated' for the need.
what_each_number_is.counted_tests_with_ambient_oxygen: Of those, the tests with o2_pct recorded and o2_basis 'ambient'.
what_each_number_is.gravity.*: Number of tests whose gravity_level equals the scenario's, and where gravity_level in tests.csv comes from.
what_each_number_is.joint.hull_kind, joint.hull_vertices_ccw: Convex hull of those points: 'area', 'segment', 'point' or 'none', with its vertices counter-clockwise.
what_each_number_is.joint.nearest_tests_pareto: Tests not dominated in (|delta o2_pct|, |delta pressure_kpa|), each with both deltas and its source file and row.
what_each_number_is.joint.nominal_position, joint.nominal_in: 'interior', 'boundary' or 'outside' of the nominal point relative to the hull; boundary counts as inside.
what_each_number_is.joint.tests_with_both_recorded, joint.di: Tests with ambient oxygen and pressure both recorded, and the number of distinct (o2_pct, pressure_kpa) points among them.
what_each_number_is.order.counts: For one table, one quantity and one pair of condition columns: the number of material pairs in each class (same_order, reversed, tie_in_one, tie_in_both).
what_each_number_is.order.kendall_tau_b: Kendall tau-b of the two columns over all material pairs, as numerator, integer under the square root and rounded decimal.
what_each_number_is.order.reversed_and_tie_in_one_pairs: Every material pair that is reversed or tied in one column only, with the four printed values.
what_each_number_is.ranges.*: Number of tests inside the scenario's oxygen range, inside its pressure range, and inside both; the last equals tests_atmosphere of scenario_needs.csv (checked).

what_these_numbers_cannot_say: Whether a material burns, or how, at a scenario's nominal point: no outcome variable is read by the envelope numbers.
Anything about a point inside the hull beyond the existence of tests on several sides of it: no value is interpolated.
Anything about gravity levels other than the ones in tests.csv: every test there carries a gravity level that the team's source mapping sets as a constant per table.
Which of two materials is more flammable in a scenario: the order tables are normal-gravity or drop-tower results printed by the authors, at the printed conditions only.
Whether a difference of one printed unit is a real difference: the items state no measurement uncertainty or step size.
Whether the counted tests are the right tests for a need: that is the pipeline's linking rule (needs.json, stated_by), not arithmetic.
